obernants.operator: Retain each tag's compatible input fiber. Cover cardinality loses graph edges; inverse assignments recover priority only under common complete preferences; roots lose the sign representative; match vectors lose unmatched bytes; minimal indices lose text; minima lose larger values; inversion totals lose ordering; normalized transforms recover residues but not integer lifts; OR convolution admits multiple factor pairs. Reverse composition preserves identical shared coordinates. Passing transcripts also admit implementations differing outside tested bounds; no unique cause or general inverse is inferred.

obernants.operator: For all 512 three-by-three bipartite graphs, the unit-capacity source-left/right-sink network preserves vertices. Every edge meets the returned cover; cover size equals matching size and Dinic flow, which equals its returned source-side cut capacity. Exclude uncovered edges or scalar disagreement. Equal cardinality leaves graph, matching and cover ambiguity. Cost composes reached matching/flow traversals on bounded networks; no dense-network performance claim.

obernants.operator: For p<=100 primality equals sieve membership and composites reject sqrt_mod. For prime p and 0<=a<p, the result equals the first ascending brute root or None; returned r satisfies pow(r,2,p)=a and r<=p-r. Exclude composite-domain success, nonroots and the larger unequal sign representative. Squaring identifies r and p-r; canonicalization cannot recover integer lifts. Costs include bounded root enumeration and exact modular arithmetic.

obernants.operator: All binary texts through length six and patterns through four satisfy Shift-And=KMP=the starts_with boundary oracle. Empty patterns include the terminal boundary and overlaps remain. A 64-byte all-255 pattern in 66 bytes returns [0,1,2]; length 65 errors. Exclude character-coordinate substitution, lost overlaps and top-bit errors. Match vectors cannot recover nonmatching bytes; patterns longer than 64 are outside the successful equality domain.
